errors.text_span: 图表中包含四组颜色不同的柱状图，分别代表 i-vector、d-vector 和 s-vector 三种特征提取方法。
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the chart represents three feature extraction methods. The legend and the grouped bars clearly show four distinct categories: "无" (None), "i-vector", "d-vector", and "s-vector".
The legend indicates that "i-vector" is represented by blue bars, not green. The green bars represent the "无" (None) category.

errors.text_span: 大约在 37% 至 34% 范围内
errors.evidence: This range is associated with the misidentified "i-vector" series. The actual range for the "i-vector" series (blue bars) is approximately 26% to 33%. The range for the green bars ("无") is approximately 31% to 38%. The stated range is incorrect for both.
The legend indicates that "s-vector" is represented by dark green bars, not blue. The blue bars represent the "i-vector" category.

errors.text_span: 大约在 31% 至 27% 范围内
errors.evidence: This range is given for the "d-vector" series. The actual values for the d-vector bars (yellow) range from approximately 24.5% to 30%. The stated range is inaccurate.

errors.text_span: 大约在 29% 至 33% 范围内
errors.evidence: This range is associated with the misidentified "s-vector" series. The actual range for the "s-vector" series (dark green bars) is approximately 24% to 29.5%. The stated range is incorrect.

errors.text_span: 在每个测试集上，这三种特征提取方法都生成一个柱状图。
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly claims there are three bars per group. The chart clearly shows four bars in each group, one for each of the four categories in the legend.
